title: Four Poses of Warrior Woman
description: Four identical side-by-side panels showing a female warrior with long dark hair in a high ponytail, wearing a red and black outfit with corset, short skirt, gauntlets and laced boots. She stands in a combat stance with fists raised against a plain gray background.
prompt: A young female warrior with long flowing dark red hair in a high ponytail and bangs, wearing a revealing red and black corset top with matching short skirt, red gauntlets, and tall black lace-up boots. She stands in a dynamic fighting stance with fists raised and legs apart, looking toward the viewer with a confident expression, shown as four identical panels arranged horizontally against a solid neutral gray background, digital painting style with clean lines and dramatic lighting
